name: tinymd
description: tinymd — 一个安静的 Markdown 工作空间
author: weiwenjie

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run build:icon && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:icon && vite build && cross-env ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win
scripts.unpack: npm run build:icon && vite build && cross-env ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --dir
